svg.aria-label: Empty can and full can: supraspinatus — 空罐试验与满罐试验：冈上肌

text.aria-label: Empty can and full can: supraspinatus — 空罐试验与满罐试验：冈上肌
text.tspan: Empty can and full can: supraspinatus
空罐试验与满罐试验：冈上肌

text.aria-label: Examiner pushes or moves — 检查者施力或移动
Patient pushes or holds — 病人用力或保持
Start or end position — 起始或结束位置
Empty can: thumbs point down — 空罐：拇指朝下
Arms at 90° in the scapular plane, fully internally rotated — 手臂在肩胛平面抬到 90°，充分内旋
text.tspan: Arms at 90° in the scapular plane, fully internally rotated
手臂在肩胛平面抬到 90°，充分内旋

text.aria-label: Full can: thumbs point up — 满罐：拇指朝上
Same position, but the arms are turned out about 45° (external rotation) — 体位相同，但手臂外旋约 45°
text.tspan: Same position, but the arms are turned out about 45° (external rotation)
体位相同，但手臂外旋约 45°

text.aria-label: The examiner pushes both arms down at the same time; the patient resists. Compare the two sides. — 检查者同时向下压两侧手臂，病人对抗。两侧对比。
text.tspan: The examiner pushes both arms down at the same time; the patient resists. Compare the two sides.
检查者同时向下压两侧手臂，病人对抗。两侧对比。

text.aria-label: Seen from above: where the arms point — 从上往下看：手臂指向哪里
text.tspan: Seen from above: where the arms point
从上往下看：手臂指向哪里

text.aria-label: Scapular plane: about 30° in front of the coronal plane. — 肩胛平面：在冠状面前方约 30°。
text.tspan: Scapular plane: about 30° in front of the coronal plane.
肩胛平面：在冠状面前方约 30°。

text.aria-label: In this small drawing the front of the body faces the top. — 这张小图里身体前方朝上。
text.tspan: In this small drawing the front of the body faces the top.
这张小图里身体前方朝上。
Schematic of the test position; body shapes are simplified.
检查体位示意；人体形状经过简化。
